svg.title: loaders
svg.text: Loading a 64 × 64 tile with 32 × 32 threads (F = 2): strided vs contiguous
warp = lanes tx 0–31 at one ty (here ty = 0); 4 load instructions per thread, (s, u) ∈ {0, 1}²
zoom: row 0 of the tile (64 floats = 2 lines)
each instruction: the warp's 32 floats span 1 line
zoom: row 0 of the tile (64 floats = 2 lines)
each instruction: the warp's 32 floats span 2 lines
lanes 2 floats apart: half of each line per instruction
Measured: strided 3,635 ms vs contiguous 3,790 ms (4% apart). The u = 1 instruction reads the other half of the same
lines right after u = 0, so the cache absorbs most of the extra sectors. Same FMAs, same shared memory, same occupancy.
